title: 12 Best Mofongo & Puerto Rican Food in San Juan
description: Explore the top 12 spots for authentic Mofongo and delicious Puerto Rican cuisine in San Juan. From traditional flavors to modern interpretations, find your next favorite meal.

places.name: Raices Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mofongo Relleno de Carne Frita (Fried Pork Mofongo) or Mofongo con Camarones (Shrimp Mofongo).

places.name: El Jibarito
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pescado Entero Frito (Whole Fried Fish) with a side of mofongo, or Bistec Encebollado (Steak with Onions).

places.name: La Casita Blanca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Anything on the daily specials board! Try the Chuletas Can-Can (fried pork chops) or stewed chicken, served with arroz y habichuelas (rice and beans) and tostones.

places.name: Jose Enrique
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask your server for the daily specials, especially any fresh seafood or pork dishes. The mofongo here is often prepared with a refined twist.

places.name: Santaella
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the 'Croquetas de Mofongo', the 'Pulpo a la Gallega' (Galician-style octopus), or the fresh catch of the day. Don't skip their impressive cocktail menu.

places.name: Punto de Vista Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their loaded mofongos – especially the 'Mofongo Trifongo' (a blend of green plantain, ripe plantain, and yuca) or the Lobster Mofongo. Pair it with a handcrafted mojito.

places.name: Barrachina Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Piña Colada (of course!) and then explore their seafood mofongo or the Paella, which is also very popular.

places.name: Deaverdura
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of the daily stew specials like Carne Guisada (Stewed Beef) or Pollo Guisado (Stewed Chicken), served with a side of mofongo or arroz con gandules (rice with pigeon peas).

places.name: Hecho en Casa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their Mofongo with Churrasco (Skirt Steak) and chimichurri, or the unique 'Mofongo Burger' for something different.

places.name: Ajo del Pais
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Mofongo de Yuca con Churrasco' (Yuca Mofongo with Skirt Steak) or any of their seafood preparations, often infused with rich garlic flavors.

places.name: Metropol Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Arroz con Pollo' (Chicken with Rice) or the 'Ropa Vieja' (Shredded Beef) with a side of Fufu de Platano (Cuban Mofongo) or their traditional Mofongo.

places.name: Cafeteria La Playita
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their fresh catch preparations, especially the 'Mofongo Relleno de Mariscos' (Seafood Stuffed Mofongo) or their whole fried fish.
